usedFor: Paymo holds tracked projects and tasks, and Asana receives them when “New Task” runs “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in Paymo, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Teams working in both tools get each new Paymo task in Asana without retyping.

watchOut: “New Project Created” in Asana is polling, so “Create Task” in Paymo runs after a scheduled check.
